releases.displayName: Available Now! Free Major Update: BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons Boosted!

notes.title: The all-new action game in the “BUBBLE BOBBLE” series, “BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons,” is getting a free major update to “BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons Boosted” today!

items.text: With this update, Bub’s brother Bob joins the adventure to help out! He’ll lead you to bonus stages where you can defeat lots of enemies at once or skip floors!

New drop items and much higher drop rates give the excitement of dungeon exploration a big “BOOST”! The game has also been rebalanced, with extra lives and easier ways to power up Bub, making it even more fun and easier to play!
There’s also a new bundle discount with “BUBBLE BOBBLE 4 FRIENDS: The Baron's Workshop”! Don’t miss this great deal—try the powered-up “Sugar Dungeons” today!
For details on the update, please check past news or the website below!

releases.displayName: Important Notice Regarding the Update to "BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons Boosted"

items.text: As the update includes adjustments to the unlock and clear conditions for missions, playing the updated game without deleting your existing save data from BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons may cause the missions to not function correctly.
We apologize for the inconvenience, but we kindly ask that you delete your existing save data before playing when updating to BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons Boosted.
1. In your Steam Library, right-click BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons, select Properties, go to General (or Steam Cloud), and uncheck Keep game saves in the Steam Cloud for BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons.
2. On your PC or drive where BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons is installed, search for the "BB5Project" folder (there may be multiple folders with the same name).
3. Delete the following two files located inside the ""BB5Project"" folder:
savedata_game.json
savedata_system.json"
4. Launch and play BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons Boosted.

5. After finishing play, right-click BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons Boosted in your Steam Library > Properties > Steam Cloud > Check the box for "Keep game saves in the Steam Cloud for BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons Boosted".
6. When launching the game again, if the "Cloud Conflict" window appears, select "Local Save".
We look forward to your continued support of BUBBLE BOBBLE Sugar Dungeons.

releases.displayName: Major Free Update Confirmed: "Bubble Bobble Sugar Dungeon Boost" Arrives August!

items.text: A major free update transforming Bubble Bobble Sugar Dungeon into Bubble Bobble Sugar Dungeon Boost has been confirmed! The update is scheduled to launch on August 20, 2026!

This update brings exciting new elements designed to heighten your anticipation and satisfaction when taking on dungeons. Additionally, various balance adjustments will be implemented based on valuable feedback from our players.

notes.title: 🌟 Double the Fun with Bobblun's Bonus Gates!

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45675555/9e621a5bc0ef55d39fd04fee4cc25b9ae81818ab.jpg"]

Bob, the twin brother of the main character Bub, is here to support Bub on his adventure! When you pass through a Bob Gate inside a dungeon, you can choose your destination from three fantastic Bonus Gates:
Treasure Stage: A stage packed with treasure chests and items.
Combo Stage: A stage where you can defeat enemies all at once to rack up combos.
Skip Gate: A gate that lets you leap past multiple floors instantly.
Enjoy choosing the perfect bonus for your situation as you dive deeper into the adventure!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45675555/1eb9bc8e4838a5f23fd4decc689a1367b18a175a.png"]
The variety and drop rates of items—such as invincibility power-ups—have been significantly boosted! Furthermore, new powerful items have been added to aid you on your journey.

⚠️ Important Note Regarding Save Data: Because this update includes adjustments to mission unlocking and completion conditions, continuing to play with your existing Bubble Bobble Sugar Dungeon save data after the update may prevent you from accessing some of the new content and fixes.

To fully experience all the new features, we kindly ask that you delete your existing save data before playing the updated game. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding.
